status: Usuario aprobó Aurora y Prisma; rechazó Nácar. Lámina conceptual; sprites finales en Images/orbita/naves/aurora y prisma.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single art-direction concept sheet for the TYPELY children's typing game spaceship shop; these are draft designs for user approval, not final sprite atlas.
Reference image: attached existing approved Órbita ship is the exact design and rendering style baseline.
Create a polished wide 3-column concept presentation showing THREE spaceship proposals, one fully visible ship per column, all at the SAME camera angle and scale as the reference: rear overhead three-quarter view, nose and shooting crystal pointing straight UP, two visible glowing rear thrusters at bottom, flying away/upward, opaque oval canopy and NO visible characters.
Background: solid deep midnight blue #101748, very restrained subtle blue halo behind each ship, generous negative space; no checkerboard, no floor, no distracting scenery.
Left proposal title “NÁCAR” small tasteful white capitals BELOW the ship: affordable cosmetic variation. Preserve EXACT reference silhouette, oval canopy, twin engine placement, curved short wings and crystal tip. Change mint body inlays to soft pearlescent rose, lavender-metal engine collars, champagne gold trim, cyan crystal. Very recognizably the original ship with elegant small finishes.
Middle title “AURORA”: visibly premium new design in the SAME original pearly white, mint, lavender, cyan, light gold palette. More flowing manta-like sculpted wings, two separated slim curved outer winglets with mint luminous inlays, beautiful lavender oval cockpit, distinct twin rear engines, graceful balanced outline, tiny integrated gold star insignia. Single cyan nose crystal remains the weapon muzzle. Designed so outer winglets can later bank as animated components; no detached ornaments. Refined, compact and legible at 140px.
Right title “PRISMA”: most elaborate premium proposal, same friendly rounded toy-quality 3D style and palette, NOT angular militaristic. Pearl compact central hull, broad swept wings with three inset faceted translucent cyan/lilac crystals at each wing shoulder, ornate gold collars around two large jewel-like circular engines, a small floating luminous ring closely enclosing each engine mouth (clearly attached energy effect). Lavender curved canopy, one prominent nose shooting crystal. Luxurious richer silhouette yet readable at small game scale. No weapons other than friendly crystal emitter, no spikes.
All three: sculpted high-quality soft 3D render, creamy ceramic finish, glossy gem materials, soft specular highlights, restrained bloom, clean silhouettes, no motion blur, no speed lines across ship, no long exhaust flames obscuring engine geometry. Keep each entire ship separated from the others with adequate margins. No extra text, prices, rarity badges, game UI, characters or watermark. Exactly three ships. Landscape composition.
